a38.question: If we downgrade from Business to Team, what happens to SSO and how many API requests per minute do we get?
a38.answer: A downgrade from Business to Team takes effect at the end of a billing period. [1] SSO is a Business-only feature. It is switched off when the downgrade takes effect, and SSO users have to set a password. [1] On the Team plan the API allows 60 requests per minute per token. Business allows 300 per minute. a39.question: What is the per diem for a full day away, and by when must I submit the expense?
a39.answer: For travel within Germany, the per diem for a full day away is 28 euros. [1] For trips abroad, the official country rates apply instead. [1] Expenses must be submitted within 30 days after the trip. You submit them with form EX-2 in the finance portal and include a photo of every receipt. u11.answer: The sources give only general API rate limits per token: 60 requests per minute on the Team plan and 300 requests per minute on the Business plan. [1] For Enterprise, the limits are set in the contract, with a default of 1,000 requests per minute. [1] If the limit is exceeded, the API returns HTTP 429 with error code TB-4290, and the Retry-After header gives the number of seconds to wait. [1] The sources do not mention a GraphQL endpoint, so it is unclear whether these general limits apply to it or whether it has its own limit.
